response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced (18+ years) and versatile senior/staff engineer with strong software craftsmanship, leadership, and mentoring credentials, but the resume shows very limited direct evidence of the core GenAI requirements for this role: no explicit Python experience, no mention of RAG architectures, vector databases, LLM evaluation/observability, or multi-agent frameworks like LangGraph/CrewAI. His only AI-related work is a brief, recent (since April 2025) mention of MCP tooling at re:cinq, which is far short of the 8+ years of AI-solution development and customer-facing technical discovery experience the role demands.
strengths: 18+ years of diverse, senior-level software engineering across web, mobile, desktop, and embedded systems
Recent hands-on exposure to MCP (Model Context Protocol) and agentic workflow tooling at current role
Strong technical leadership, mentoring, and public speaking/workshop experience demonstrating staff-level influence
concerns: No demonstrated Python experience, despite it being a core required language for the role
No evidence of RAG architectures, vector databases, or LLM performance/evaluation work anywhere in the resume
AI/GenAI-specific experience is minimal, recent (a few months), and lacks depth or production-scale detail

key_factors.factor: Lack of demonstrated RAG/vector DB/GenAI production experience
No explicit Python or major cloud platform AI system-building experience
Extensive general staff-level engineering seniority and leadership
